$comment: email-communication-intelligence-r1 task 030 (NFR-07 blocking merge gate) — the email-propose (Job B) eval family, joined to the SAME Category=GoldenUtteranceEval merge gate via ProposeFieldUpdatesEvalTests.cs (identical net-new-family pattern as the triage-email / NDA-review / Assistant-Enhancements-R1 families in this directory — no shared golden-utterances.json edit for the family, no CI-YAML change; the trait IS the registration). Like TRIAGE-EMAIL, PROPOSE-FIELD-UPDATES is NOT chat/loop-projectable — it is invoked directly off the Communication enrichment path (CommunicationEnrichmentService.RunEmailProposeAsync via the ICommunicationProposeAi PublicContracts facade), so 'channel' is uniformly 'event' and 'utterance' is the event/affordance descriptor, not NL phrasing. Four families: structured-output (the Action's own worked example → the proposals[] output shape {field, newValue, citation{source, locator, quotedText}, reason, confidence}, cross-checked against BOTH the action file and this seed so either drifting fails a test), verify-cited-text (NFR-06 — the CitationVerifier drops a fabricated quote, keeps a verbatim span), binding-resolution (the email-propose Binding resolves through the REAL ConsumerRoutingService to the propose-field-updates Action), no-second-pass (FR-05/FR-09 — the facade has NO classification dependency; the triage output is grounding only).
